objectives: Understand revenue drivers and regional performance
data.datasetSummary: This dataset contains sales information across four regions (North, South, East, West) with four product types (Laptop, Phone, Tablet), tracking units sold, revenue generated, and transaction dates from January to April 2025.

kpis.label: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Overall revenue generated across all regions and products

kpis.label: Average Units per Transaction
kpis.description: Average quantity of products sold per transaction

kpis.label: Revenue per Unit
kpis.description: Average revenue generated per unit sold

kpis.label: Revenue by Region
kpis.description: Total revenue generated by each region

kpis.label: Product Mix by Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue contribution by each product type

charts.title: Revenue by Region and Product
charts.reason: Shows which products contribute to revenue in each region, helping identify regional preferences and top-performing products

charts.title: Average Revenue per Region
charts.reason: Compares average revenue performance across regions to identify top and underperforming regions

charts.title: Revenue Trend Over Time
charts.reason: Shows revenue progression over the time period to identify seasonal patterns or growth trends

charts.title: Units vs Revenue Relationship
charts.reason: Visualizes the relationship between units sold and revenue to understand pricing and product mix impact

tests.description: Tests the strength of relationship between units sold and revenue to understand pricing consistency

data.notes: The dataset is small (10 rows) which may limit statistical significance. The 'Units' and 'Revenue' columns are marked as ID-like, which may indicate they should be treated as transaction identifiers rather than measures. No time-based analysis is possible beyond monthly aggregation due to limited date points.
